title: Synthesis of Nanoparticles of FeZn by Reactive Milling and Washing by Means of Evaporated Alcohol
content: Mechanical reactive grinding is a physical method to synthesize nanoparticles. During processing, the desired compounds are introduced into the milling device and in the chemically required proportions to be milled for a sufficiently long time. In this investigation a Spex milling device is used and the goal is to synthesize Fe-50Zn nanoparticles. To prevent coagulation or agglomeration of the nanoparticles, NaCl is added in a 1:1 ratio as a dispersant.
